cohort: The study included 102 pregnant women with diabetic kidney disease (DKD) with a history of pregestational diabetes of at least 20 years' duration and/or onset before age 10, or pregestational diabetes complicated by hypertension or diabetic retinopathy, and elevated urinary protein loss or overt proteinuria.
finding: Elevated sFlt-1 levels, decreased PlGF levels, and an increased sFlt-1/PlGF ratio during the second and third trimesters were significant predictors of preeclampsia development in pregnant women with diabetic kidney disease.
gest_age: Measurements were taken at the 20th and 30th weeks of gestation.
